description: Credential and keypair metadata must be preserved exactly, as must every member this reader does not understand
credentialMetadata: OPTIONAL array of {type: non-empty string, value: any JSON}; stored exactly as supplied, order preserved, duplicate types allowed, absent (never null, never []) when empty
unknownMembers: Every unrecognised member of an S.credentials[] entry and of S MUST be preserved with an identical value; an implementation that cannot MUST refuse to rewrite
